overview: A multi-worker shift time tracker with offline-first start/end shift timing, notes, and monthly reports.
features: Start and end shifts with a live counting timer
Works offline and syncs when the device reconnects
Each shift capped at 10 continuous hours
Workers sign in with their own email and see only their own shifts
Add notes to any shift as a worker or the owner
Monthly reports with total hours and per-shift breakdown
Owner can view all workers and correct shift records
